slots.headline: Four steps from the door to the archive

nodes.title: Validate and normalise records
nodes.label: Step one: intake now
nodes.text: Takes each inbound record, checks each field and parks bad rows aside for later.

nodes.title: Enrich every record with owner
nodes.label: Step two: enrichment
nodes.text: Looks up the owner of each record, adds the team name and flags missing owners.

nodes.title: Batch the records for workers
nodes.label: Step three: batching
nodes.text: Splits the records into batches of fifty and sends each batch to the next worker.

nodes.title: Archive, then clean up files
nodes.label: Step four: archiving
nodes.text: Writes each batch to the archive, checks the copy and then clears old files.

slots.caption: Every record takes the same four steps in the same order, and nothing moves on until the step before it is done. Always. Always. Always. Alw

slots.headline: One step does four jobs on its own

nodes.title: Clean each record in turn
nodes.text: The busiest step in the whole flow, run once.

nodes.title: Publish
nodes.text: Send it out to every team.

slots.caption: Every record takes the same four steps in the same order, and nothing moves on until the step before it is done. Always. Always. Always. Alw

callout.text: The middle step is where nearly all of the time goes, so we watch it more closely than the rest of the flow, every day.
